creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers oil and gas exploration, production and LNG in detail and shows no creative activity; technology licensing is an excluded trap.

community.reason: Level 2: only employee development and recruitment activities are described, so the score is capped at 2.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 1: the filing gives general inclusive-environment language, employees-by-country statistics and standard benefits, but no specific inclusion, access or community-connecting activity.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: the filing shows only the company's own innovation (LNG technology licensing) and no service or program enabling founders or small businesses.

evidence.activity: Employee development through on-the-job learning, formal training, feedback, coaching and mentoring
evidence.quote: We engage and develop our workforce through on-the-job learning, formal training, ongoing feedback, coaching and mentoring.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Management > Valuing our People > Employee Engagement and Development

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: Partnerships with universities and organizations to build an early-career recruiting pipeline
evidence.quote: We recruit experienced hires to help us sustain a broad range of expertise and partner with universities and organizations to create a pipeline of early-career talent.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Management > Attracting a World-Class Workforce

community.criterion: level 2: recruitment pipeline for future staff, with no described education program, so treated as workforce development

evidence.activity: Employee benefits covering disability support, elder care and childcare, including onsite childcare where local access is limited
evidence.quote: We also provide coverage for disability support, elder care and childcare, including onsite childcare, where access locally is a challenge.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Management > Valuing our People > Compensation, Benefits and Well-Being

cross_cultural.criterion: level 1: standard benefits, not a targeted inclusion practice for underrepresented groups

evidence.activity: Licensing of the company's proprietary LNG liquefaction technology
evidence.quote: Our Optimized Cascade® LNG liquefaction technology has been licensed for use in 28 LNG trains around the world, with FEED studies ongoing for additional trains.

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 1: company's own innovation, not enabling founders or small businesses

notes: Item 7 (targeted) contained only a reference to the Emergency Planning and Community Right-to-Know Act, which is a regulatory trap and was not counted. Oil spill response organization memberships and emergency response partnerships are industry operational-preparedness cooperatives, not community investment or education, so they were not counted. The employees-by-country table and operations in 14 countries are demographics and international operations only. The 'Innovation' SPIRIT value and the 'inclusive environment' statement are general language. Licensing of Optimized Cascade® technology is a technology license, not creative licensing.
